records.source: On rainy days my thoughts always drift toward cinnamon and cookies.
records.translation: Kapag maulan, laging napapadako sa kanela at mga biskuwit ang isip ko.

records.source: I wonder if Maru and Dr. Harvey will ever get together? I'm sure Harvey likes her...#$e#I think Maru will have to make the first move, though.$h
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung magkakatuluyan kaya sina Maru at Dr. Harvey? Tiyak akong gusto siya ni Harvey...#$e#Pero sa tingin ko, si Maru ang kailangang gumawa ng unang hakbang.$h

records.source: Hi, honey! I did some shopping this morning and got this for you.[186 180 770 535]#$e#I thought you could really use one of those.$11
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Namili ako kaninang umaga at binili ko ito para sa iyo.[186 180 770 535]#$e#Naisip kong talagang magagamit mo ang isa sa mga ito.$11

records.source: Hmm... maybe I should experiment with a new recipe. You liked the last recipe I made, didn't you, honey?#$e#What was it called... 'Chili de @'?
records.translation: Hmm... baka dapat akong sumubok ng bagong resipe. Nagustuhan mo ang huling resipeng ginawa ko, hindi ba, mahal?#$e#Ano nga ang tawag doon... “Chili de @”?

records.source: On days like this, I love to curl up with a good book.
records.translation: Sa mga araw na tulad nito, gustong-gusto kong pumulupot sa kumot kasama ang isang magandang aklat.

records.source: How was your day, honey? I spent my afternoon reading a novel.
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo, mahal? Ginugol ko ang hapon sa pagbabasa ng nobela.

records.source: This is a lot more peaceful than my old spot in town. I'm very happy here.
records.translation: Di-hamak na mas payapa rito kaysa sa dati kong lugar sa bayan. Napakasaya ko rito.

records.source: I'm sure Mom's at the saloon right now... But I don't feel so bad about it anymore. It's out of my hands.
records.translation: Tiyak akong nasa Stardrop Saloon ngayon si Nanay... Pero hindi na ganoon kasama ang pakiramdam ko tungkol doon. Wala na akong magagawa.

records.source: I was just thinking about that night we met in the bathhouse.$l#$e#I'll never forget that night...$l
records.translation: Iniisip ko lang ang gabing nagkita tayo sa paliguan.$l#$e#Hindi ko kailanman malilimutan ang gabing iyon...$l

records.source: The sound of rain used to bother me, when I lived in that old metal trailer. But it's quite soothing here.
records.translation: Naiinis ako noon sa tunog ng ulan noong nakatira pa ako sa lumang treyler na metal. Pero nakagiginhawa ito rito.

records.source: I felt like making a nice dinner. I hope you like it. [212 214 225 209 200]$h
records.translation: Naisipan kong maghanda ng masarap na hapunan. Sana magustuhan mo. [212 214 225 209 200]$h

records.source: It's so peaceful here. I used to have the most horrific nightmares, but now I sleep like a baby.
records.translation: Napakapayapa rito. Napakasasama ng mga bangungot ko noon, pero ngayon ay natutulog akong parang sanggol.

records.source: Good morning, @! I made you a hot breakfast.[195 210 211]#$e#It's important to me that you leave here with a full belly.$h
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @! Ipinaghanda kita ng mainit na almusal.[195 210 211]#$e#Mahalaga sa akin na umalis kang busog.$h

records.source: You know, I think I'll read a book today. I picked up something new from the library last time I was there.#$e#Gunther asked me to say hi.
records.translation: Alam mo, sa tingin ko ay magbabasa ako ng aklat ngayon. May bago akong hiniram sa aklatan noong huli akong naroon.#$e#Nagpapakumusta si Gunther.

records.source: I love to hear about all the artifacts you've found. Archaeology is fascinating!#$e#To think... there may have been farmers at this very spot 10,000 years ago.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong marinig ang tungkol sa lahat ng artepaktong natagpuan mo. Kahanga-hanga ang arkeolohiya!#$e#Isipin mo... baka may mga magsasaka sa mismong lugar na ito 10,000 taon na ang nakalipas.

records.source: Was I shy when we first met? It's funny to think about, now that we've come so far.$h
records.translation: Mahiyain ba ako noong una tayong nagkita? Nakakatawang isipin ngayon dahil napakalayo na ng narating natin.$h

records.source: Good evening, honey. Did you accomplish everything you wanted to today?#$e#If not, that's okay. We've got all the time in the world!
records.translation: Magandang gabi, mahal. Natapos mo ba ang lahat ng gusto mong gawin ngayon?#$e#Kung hindi, ayos lang. Napakarami pa nating panahon!

records.source: Hmm... skirt or pants tomorrow? Oh, who am I kidding... I always go with the skirt.
records.translation: Hmm... palda o pantalon bukas? Ah, sino ba ang niloloko ko... palda naman lagi ang pinipili ko.

records.source: We have it good here. We should always try and remember those less fortunate than us.#$e#I'm just very grateful for what we have.
records.translation: Maganda ang buhay natin dito. Dapat lagi nating alalahanin ang mga hindi kasingpalad natin.#$e#Lubos lang akong nagpapasalamat sa mayroon tayo.

records.source: Mom's probably pretty lonely now that I'm gone. I just hope she doesn't visit the saloon more to make up for it.#$e#You shouldn't feel bad! Mom has to solve her own problems.
records.translation: Malamang napakalungkot ni Nanay ngayong wala na ako. Sana hindi niya mas dalasan ang pagpunta sa Stardrop Saloon upang punan ang pangungulila niya.#$e#Huwag kang makonsensiya! Kailangang lutasin ni Nanay ang sarili niyang mga problema.

records.source: Ready to tuck in? I made the bed and everything...$11
records.translation: Handa ka nang matulog? Inayos ko na ang kama at ang lahat ng kailangan...$11

records.source: I only ever dreamed of living in such a beautiful place, and now it's come true.#$e#I was so miserable back home.$s
records.translation: Pinangarap ko lang noon ang tumira sa ganitong kagandang lugar, at ngayon ay nagkatotoo na iyon.#$e#Malungkot na malungkot ako sa dati kong tahanan.$s

records.source: Isn't this a perfect place to raise children?#$e#I would've been so happy growing up on a farm.
records.translation: Hindi ba perpektong lugar ito para magpalaki ng mga anak?#$e#Napakasaya ko sana kung lumaki ako sa isang bukid.

records.source: Hi, honey! If I knew more about farm work I'd help you out more. Sorry!#$e#I'll be thinking of you.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Kung mas marami akong alam tungkol sa trabaho sa bukid, mas matutulungan sana kita. Pasensiya na!#$e#Iisipin kita.$h

records.source: I just saw a songbird flying due west. In Stardew Valley that's a very good omen.$h
records.translation: May nakita akong ibong mang-aawit na lumilipad patungong kanluran. Napakagandang palatandaan niyan sa Stardew Valley.$h

records.source: Ahh... It feels great to be outside. I could spend all day right here, observing every little thing.
records.translation: Ahh... Ang sarap ng pakiramdam sa labas. Kaya kong gugulin ang buong araw dito mismo, pinagmamasdan ang bawat munting bagay.

records.source: Have you had any time to play with %kid1 today? Maybe a second child will make things better.
records.translation: Nagkaroon ka ba ng oras na makipaglaro kay %kid1 ngayon? Baka maging mas maayos ang lahat kapag may pangalawang anak.

records.source: Little %kid1 is going to have such a great childhood here.
records.translation: Magkakaroon ng napakagandang pagkabata dito ang munting si %kid1.

records.source: I feel a lot older now that we have a child. Maybe it's just this new responsibility weighing on me.#$e#It's not bad! I've wanted this for a long time.$11
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay mas matanda na ako ngayong may anak na tayo. Baka dahil lang sa bigat ng bagong pananagutang ito.#$e#Hindi ito masama! Matagal ko na itong nais.$11

records.source: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their food. They're such hungry children!
records.translation: Napakain ko na sina %kid1 at %kid2. Lagi silang gutom!

records.source: We have to make sure and give %kid1 a lot of attention now that we have %kid2. We don't want any jealousy between them.
records.translation: Kailangan nating tiyaking mabigyan pa rin ng maraming pansin si %kid1 ngayong narito na si %kid2. Ayaw nating magselos sila sa isa’t isa.

records.source: I've had this dream that %kid2 grew wings and flew into the night sky. What does it mean?
records.translation: Nanaginip akong nagkaroon ng mga pakpak si %kid2 at lumipad sa kalangitan sa gabi. Ano kaya ang ibig sabihin noon?

records.source: A nice house, two wonderful kids, and a beautiful plot of land. We're so very fortunate.
records.translation: Magandang bahay, dalawang kahanga-hangang anak, at magandang lupain. Napakapalad natin.

records.source: @...I still can't believe we're married...$l
records.translation: @... Hindi pa rin ako makapaniwalang kasal na tayo...$l

records.source: I had dreams of marrying you for such a long time.$l
records.translation: Napakatagal kong pinangarap na pakasalan ka.$l

records.source: I knew you were the one from the moment you moved here...$l
records.translation: Alam kong ikaw na ang para sa akin mula nang lumipat ka rito...$l

records.source: Wow, you look really handsome today! Did you shave?$l^Wow, you look beautiful today. Did you do something different with your hair?$l
records.translation: Grabe, napakakisig mo ngayon! Nag-ahit ka ba?$l^Grabe, napakaganda mo ngayon. May iba ka bang ginawa sa buhok mo?$l

records.source: This place is really starting to feel like home.$l
records.translation: Nagsisimula na talagang maging tahanan ang lugar na ito.$l

records.source: Be careful out there! Sometimes I worry that you aren't eating enough wholesome food.
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon! Minsan ay nag-aalala akong hindi sapat ang masustansiyang pagkaing kinakain mo.

records.source: I'm going to head into town today, just for fun. I'll be back in a while!
records.translation: Pupunta ako sa bayan ngayon para maglibang. Babalik ako maya-maya!

records.source: I had a nice time... It's good to stay in contact with everyone. Tell me about your day.
records.translation: Naging masaya ako... Mabuting patuloy na makipag-ugnayan sa lahat. Ikuwento mo sa akin ang araw mo.

records.source: Spring is probably my favorite season. There's a certain freshness in the air that fills me with hope.
records.translation: Marahil tagsibol ang paborito kong panahon. May kakaibang kasariwaan sa hangin na pumupuno sa akin ng pag-asa.

records.source: We've got a long, warm year to look forward to. Let's make it a productive one.
records.translation: Mahaba at mainit na taon ang maaasahan natin. Gawin natin itong mabunga.

records.source: Ah, the 'spring cleaning'... I'm actually going to enjoy this.
records.translation: Ah, ang “malawakang paglilinis sa tagsibol”... Talagang masisiyahan ako rito.

records.source: *phew*... I need to eat more melon to combat this heat!
records.translation: *hingal*... Kailangan kong kumain ng mas maraming melon para labanan ang init na ito!

records.source: Summer may be searing hot, but the humidity feels great on the skin.
records.translation: Maaaring napakatindi ng init sa tag-init, pero napakasarap sa balat ng halumigmig.

records.source: In summer, the ants become very active. I could watch them for hours... they have a pretty complex civilization from the looks of it!
records.translation: Napakaaktibo ng mga langgam kapag tag-init. Kaya kong pagmasdan sila nang ilang oras... mukhang masalimuot ang kabihasnan nila!

records.source: The smell of fall reminds me of the smell of books... weird, isn't it?
records.translation: Ipinaaalala sa akin ng amoy ng taglagas ang amoy ng mga aklat... kakaiba, hindi ba?

records.source: Fall... It makes me think of colored paper and glue. Maybe I'm spending too much time with the children.$h
records.translation: Taglagas... Napapaisip ako tungkol sa makukulay na papel at pandikit. Baka sobra na ang oras na ginugugol ko kasama ang mga bata.$h

records.source: Will you grow any giant pumpkins this year?$11
records.translation: Magtatanim ka ba ng anumang dambuhalang kalabasa ngayong taon?$11

records.source: Winter's a good time to unwind a bit. You deserve it after the long year!
records.translation: Magandang panahon ang taglamig para makapagpahinga nang kaunti. Karapat-dapat iyon sa iyo matapos ang mahabang taon!

records.source: The falling snow reminds me of grandma, rocking by the fire. I have this vivid memory of her shadow, flickering against the orange wood... That was long ago.
records.translation: Ipinaaalala sa akin ng bumabagsak na niyebe si Lola habang umiindayog sa tabi ng apoy. Malinaw na malinaw sa alaala ko ang anino niyang kumikislap sa kulay-kahel na kahoy... Matagal na iyon.

records.source: How will we stay afloat this winter? Oh, you don't have to tell me... I trust you to make the right decisions.
records.translation: Paano tayo makakaraos ngayong taglamig? Ah, hindi mo kailangang sabihin sa akin... Nagtitiwala akong gagawa ka ng tamang mga pasiya.
